leave_parental_paid_009.evidence: Eligible employees can take up to 12 weeks of unpaid leave in the 12-month period from July 1-June 30.

leave_pregnancy_disability_010.evidence: Pregnancy and conditions related to pregnancy are treated the same as any other temporary disability.

leave_adoption_childcare_011.evidence: The district also permits the use of intermittent or reduced-schedule leave for the care of a newborn child or for adoption or placement of a child with the employee.

leave_fmla_012.evidence: Local Family and Medical Leave (FMLA) Provisions Eligible employees can take up to 12 weeks of unpaid leave in the 12-month period from July 1-June 30.
